notes.title: New Release! Get ZHive for $1.79 (-40%)
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone

We have launched another wallet friendly game...Zhive!

Zhive is a small and simple strategy game where you command the undead on the map by selecting the areas where you want them to spawn and then direct them to a target area. But be careful, think strategically. The soldiers are well equipped and can decimate your minions with ease. Don't let them roam around, they could restock and find the survivor!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/110f5f3f7069ae9cbfabe596cf19ef9930b577e5.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1119530/ZHIVE/

notes.title: New Release! Get ORC RAID for $3.50 [30% launch discount]
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone.

We have released a new game! Orc Raid is a first person shooter where you fight tons enemies coming at you. It features a small story mode and the classic survival mode to rank via online leaderboards. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1061160/Orc_Raid/

While this time, the game sports a more fantasy like world, It still contains our signature content..... :)

It has..... explosions!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/71cb013290e5707c581fc4203819c411be089493.gif[/img]

It has..... flying bodyparts!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/61236771fd050adb7ed10bdb9f6baf6bd972b973.gif[/img]

It has.... blood splashing everywhere!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/1f4a1404ae5e619b318cb7b7f60e51df5edc5e3c.gif[/img]

Did I mention it has flying bodyparts?
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/94e75d5eceaa76fac2dfd5dc00c02fd2b16c7caa.gif[/img]

We hope you can support us with your purchase so we can keep raising the quality bar so one day, we can produce a game that will forever be remembered. 

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Deadly Escape Update #1
notes.notes:
Deadly Escape v1.0.13 is now online! 

[h1]BugFixes/Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]The player will not get stuck anymore after repeatedly pressing the spawn door button when the door is already open.
    [*]The generator will now activate even if you close the dialogue before it fully opens.
    [*]Fixed some undead that were not attacking the player.
    [*]Fixed some instances where "shoot barrel" was randomly appearing.
    [*]The player will not turn towards the hatches and escape(without 
        "moonwalk").
    [*]The undead coming out of the bottom left hatch will not moonwalk 
        anymore during the cutscene.
    [*]Fixed the description of the key cards and fuses.
    [*]After the game is over, the cursor will now show on the screen.
    [*]When accessed via the pause menu, the fullscreen option will now 
       reflect what the player set via the main menu.
    [*]The achievements are now online.
    [*]Fixed the collision area of some props.
    [*]Arranged several graphic layers that had an incorrect order.
    [*]The boss will not get stuck anymore in the bottom left corner.
    [*]Fixed some instances where the help and dialogues overlapped each 
       other.
    [*]Fixed a bug where the guards NPC kept shooting after the undead 
        were already dead(no pun intended).
    [*]Targeting Fixes, after shooting an exploding barrel, the target will now 
       position over the closest undead.

[/list]

[h1]In development[/h1]
[list]
[*]Chapter2
[*]Leaderboards.
[*]More bug fixes. 

[/list]
[h1]Words from the devs[/h1]
[list]
[*]We still have a lot of bugs to fix, thank you for your patience!
[*]If you liked the game, support us with your review! this way we will be able to bring you as many chapters as possible!
[*]Have you played [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/618610/Endless_Horde/]Endless Horde?[/url] check it out if you have the chance. It is a minigame but it ties to the story. Can you guess how? One of the leftover notes gives you a hint.
[*]Join our new group! Once we gather enough members we'll give away cool stuff. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/ominousgaminggroup]Join us![/url]
[/list]

And as always, thanks for your support!
